# Heatmap

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Reading metadata & defense-system classification (in assemblies/)
meta <- read_metadata("metadata_updated_ecoli_systems_detail2.csv")

annotations <- read_metadata("classification_final.csv") %>%
  rename_with(str_trim) %>%
  mutate(system = str_trim(system)) %>%
  distinct(system, mechanism_category, mechanism_subcategory)

# Output directory for figures
fig_dir <- here("figures")
ensure_dir(fig_dir)
```

```{r}
# Okabe-Ito based colour-blind friendly palette for defense mechanisms
mechanism_colours <- c(
  "Abi/Cell Death"         = "#D55E00",
  "Nucleic Acid Targeting" = "#0072B2",
  "Other/Mixed"            = "#009E73",
  "DNA/RNA Modification"   = "#F0E442",
  "Uncharacterized"        = "#999999"
)

mechanism_levels <- names(mechanism_colours)
```

# 2. Prepare co-occurrence data (function)

Denominator = all unique contigs (plasmids/chromosomes) carrying a given ARG class
Numerator   = unique contigs carrying both a given PDS and a given ARG

```{r}

prepare_cooccurrence <- function(meta, contig_type) {

  n_col <- paste0("n_", tolower(contig_type), "s_with_class")   # e.g. n_plasmids_with_class

  #2.1. AMR-class table for denominators
  amr_class_totals <- meta %>%
    filter(Type == contig_type) %>%
    mutate(
      contig_uid           = str_trim(Contig),
      AMRFinderPlus4       = str_trim(AMRFinderPlus4),
      AMRFinderPlus4_Class = str_trim(AMRFinderPlus4_Class),
      AMRFinderPlus4       = na_if(AMRFinderPlus4, ""),
      AMRFinderPlus4_Class = na_if(AMRFinderPlus4_Class, "")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(AMRFinderPlus4)) %>%
    mutate(arg_class = replace_na(AMRFinderPlus4_Class, "Unclassified")) %>%
    distinct(contig_uid, arg_class) %>%
    count(arg_class, name = n_col)

# 2.2. Build contigs_long for system x ARG class co-occurrence
  contigs_long <- meta %>%
    filter(Type == contig_type) %>%
    mutate(
      contig_uid           = str_trim(Contig),
      system               = str_trim(type),
      AMRFinderPlus4       = str_trim(AMRFinderPlus4),
      AMRFinderPlus4_Class = str_trim(AMRFinderPlus4_Class),
      AMRFinderPlus4       = na_if(AMRFinderPlus4, ""),
      AMRFinderPlus4_Class = na_if(AMRFinderPlus4_Class, ""),
      system               = na_if(system, "")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(AMRFinderPlus4), !is.na(system)) %>%
    distinct(contig_uid, system, AMRFinderPlus4, AMRFinderPlus4_Class)

  #2.3. Collapse to ARG class level
  class_co_df <- contigs_long %>%
    mutate(arg_class = replace_na(AMRFinderPlus4_Class, "Unclassified")) %>%
    distinct(contig_uid, system, arg_class) %>%
    count(system, arg_class, name = "count") %>%
    left_join(amr_class_totals, by = "arg_class") %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[n_col]]), .data[[n_col]] > 0, count > 0) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = count / .data[[n_col]],
      pct_label = case_when(
        pct > 0 & pct < 0.001 ~ "<0.1%",
        TRUE ~ percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1)
      ),
      count_log   = log1p(count),
      text_colour = if_else(rescale(count_log) < 0.45, "grey10", "white")
    )

  class_co_df <- class_co_df %>%
    filter(count > 0)

  # 2.4 Ordering
  system_levels <- class_co_df %>%
    group_by(system) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(total) %>%
    pull(system)

  arg_class_levels <- class_co_df %>%
    group_by(arg_class) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(total)) %>%
    pull(arg_class)

  class_co_df <- class_co_df %>%
    mutate(
      system    = factor(system, levels = system_levels),
      arg_class = factor(arg_class, levels = arg_class_levels)
    )

  # 2.5 PDS annotation (y-axis) - labels coloured by defense mechanism
  system_annot <- tibble(system = system_levels) %>%
    left_join(annotations, by = "system") %>%
    mutate(
      mechanism_category = replace_na(mechanism_category, "Uncharacterized"),
      mechanism_category = factor(mechanism_category, levels = mechanism_levels),
      coloured_label = glue(
        "<span style='color:{mechanism_colours[as.character(mechanism_category)]}'><b>{system}</b></span>"
      ),
      system = factor(system, levels = system_levels)
    )

  system_label_map <- setNames(system_annot$coloured_label, system_annot$system)

  # 2.6 Dummy data for the mechanism legend
  legend_df <- tibble(
    x = arg_class_levels[1],
    y = system_levels[1],
    mechanism_category = factor(mechanism_levels, levels = mechanism_levels)
  )

  list(
    amr_class_totals = amr_class_totals,
    contigs_long     = contigs_long,
    class_co_df      = class_co_df,
    system_levels    = system_levels,
    arg_class_levels = arg_class_levels,
    system_label_map = system_label_map,
    legend_df        = legend_df
  )
}
```

```{r}
plasmid_prep <- prepare_cooccurrence(meta, "Plasmid")

class_co_df      <- plasmid_prep$class_co_df
system_label_map <- plasmid_prep$system_label_map
legend_df        <- plasmid_prep$legend_df
```

```{r}
chr_prep <- prepare_cooccurrence(meta, "Chromosome")

class_co_df_chr      <- chr_prep$class_co_df
system_label_map_chr <- chr_prep$system_label_map
legend_df_chr        <- chr_prep$legend_df
```

# 3. Plot plasmids (Figure 3A)

```{r}
pal <- colorpanel(1000, "#F3E79B", "darkcyan", "purple4")

fig_class_heatmap <- ggplot(class_co_df %>% filter(n_plasmids_with_class > 20), aes(x = arg_class, y = system)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = pct), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +

  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours  = pal,
    name     = "Percentage of plasmids:",
    labels   = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    breaks   = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8),
    na.value = "white",
    guide    = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 28, barheight = 1.5)
  ) +

  scale_colour_identity(guide = "none") +

  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x) unname(system_label_map[as.character(x)]),
    drop = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +

  ggnewscale::new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(
    data = legend_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, colour = mechanism_category),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0,
    size = 5,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = mechanism_colours,
    name   = "Defense mechanism:",
    guide  = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 5, shape = 15),
      nrow = 2
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x     = "ARG class",
    y     = "Phage defense systems",
    title = "A. Percentage of plasmids carrying a given ARG class \n that also carry a given defense system",
    subtitle = "for classes where >20 plasmids have a given ARG"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title        = element_text(size = 32, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size=25, vjust = 0.1, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(
      angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1,
      size = 26, face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y       = ggtext::element_markdown(hjust = 1, size = 25),
    axis.text.y.left  = ggtext::element_markdown(hjust = 1, size = 26),
    axis.title.x      = element_text(size = 27, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 13, b = 20)),
    axis.title.y      = element_text(size = 27, face = "bold"),
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.box        = "vertical",
    legend.spacing.y  = grid::unit(30, "pt"),
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold"),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 25),
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = "grey60", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    legend.box.margin     = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

fig_class_heatmap

ggsave(
  filename = "cooccurrence_heatmap_plasmids_fig3A.png",
  plot     = fig_class_heatmap,
  path     = fig_dir,
  width    = 19, height = 18, units = "in",
  dpi      = 300
)
```

# 4. Plot chromosomes (Figure S9)

```{r}
pal <- colorpanel(1000, "#F3E79B", "darkcyan", "purple4")

fig_class_heatmap_chr <- ggplot(class_co_df_chr %>% filter(n_chromosomes_with_class > 20), aes(x = arg_class, y = system)) +
```
